stages.title: Trusted repository snapshot audit
stages.purpose: Historical completed stage; preserve its verified commit and remote readback without re-execution.
required_commands: no re-execution in the A4-A8 definition bootstrap
required_outputs: verified A1 commit and remote readback
acceptance_criteria: A1 is passed at the trusted recovery point
stages.stop_rule: Do not re-run or rewrite A1 during later stages.

stages.title: Control-plane artifact correction
stages.purpose: Historical completed stage; preserve its verified commit and remote readback without re-execution.
required_commands: no re-execution in the A4-A8 definition bootstrap
required_outputs: verified A2 commit and remote readback
acceptance_criteria: A2 is passed at the trusted recovery point
stages.stop_rule: Do not re-run, amend, roll back, or rewrite A2 during later stages.

stages.title: Annual test integrity audit
stages.purpose: Historical completed stage; preserve its verified audit outputs without re-execution.
required_commands: no re-execution in the A4-A8 definition bootstrap
acceptance_criteria: A3 is passed at the trusted recovery point
stages.stop_rule: Use A3 as a read-only input to A4; do not repeat its audit here.

stages.title: Annual test baseline execution and A3 finding validation
stages.purpose: Run the 2015-2025 annual tests, establish an evidence-backed runtime baseline, and classify each A3 finding without broad repair.
forbidden_writes: original papers, archives, images, data, or trusted baseline
required_commands: python -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_2015_manual.py tests/test_2016_manual.py tests/test_2017_manual.py tests/test_2018_manual.py tests/test_2019_manual.py tests/test_2020_manual.py tests/test_2021_manual.py tests/test_2022_manual.py tests/test_2023_manual.py tests/test_2024_manual.py tests/test_2025_manual.py
python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_<year>_manual.py for each year 2015-2025
acceptance_criteria: all 11 annual test files collect successfully or have an explicit collection blocker
every annual test is run independently with an exit code
results are structured with passed, failed, skipped, error, duration, and failure IDs
every A3 finding has an allowed classification
BOM acceptance is separated from no-BOM output policy
tests and business facts are unchanged
commit, push, and remote readback pass
human_review_triggers: two independent checks conflict on a finding
a source, queue, boundary, skip, or encoding conclusion lacks evidence
stages.stop_rule: After A4 remote readback, stop. Do not execute A5 or any later stage.

stages.title: 2015-2025 status reconciliation and evidence-first repair plan
stages.purpose: Reconcile status claims against gates, checkpoints, reports, queues, missing requests, and A4 results; propose repairs without applying them.
required_commands: read and validate all authoritative inputs
validate every missing-segment request against source evidence
acceptance_criteria: each year has a status
each conflict has both evidence paths
unknown is not converted to absent
the A6 minimal repair list is machine-readable
remote readback passes
human_review_triggers: request lacks source path or hash
stages.stop_rule: After A5 remote readback, stop. Do not execute A6.

stages.title: Confirmed minimal repair and local regression
stages.purpose: Apply only A5-approved, evidence-bound minimal repairs and run affected-scope regression.
allowed_writes: only files explicitly named by the A5 repair manifest
required_commands: run targeted regression for affected years
run regression for unaffected years as required
acceptance_criteria: every repair has evidence and before/after state
targeted regression passes
affected-year regression completes
unaffected years are not changed
remote readback passes
human_review_triggers: repair scope expands beyond A5 manifest
stages.stop_rule: After A6 remote readback, stop. Do not execute A7.

stages.title: Full regression, quality gates, and cross-file consistency
stages.purpose: Run full regression and cross-file consistency checks after A6 repairs, without introducing new repairs.
authoritative_inputs: all current control and derived outputs
acceptance_criteria: hard errors are zero
all retained failures are explicitly recorded
no unrecorded skips or unsupported completion claims
cross-file consistency passes
remote readback passes
human_review_triggers: quality gate cannot distinguish incomplete from passed
stages.stop_rule: After A7 remote readback, stop. Do not execute A8.

stages.title: Final summary, release checkpoint, and remote delivery
stages.purpose: Summarize A1-A7, create the final recovery and verification package, and deliver it with remote readback; do not add business repairs.
forbidden_writes: absolute paths, secrets, cache, or temporary files
required_commands: binary readback of key final files
acceptance_criteria: final files parse strictly
local and remote content match
working tree is clean
recovery instructions are complete
no incomplete year is represented as complete
human_review_triggers: final status cannot be supported by A1-A7 evidence
remote readback differs from local bytes
stages.stop_rule: A8 is the terminal stage. Do not start another stage automatically.
